method: Publication requires a current official first-party roster or directory.
Maps and general web search were used only to discover official sources.
Statistical totals without current names remain candidates and are not published.
Separate canonical jurisdictions were audited independently rather than inferred from the Polish Church roster.

candidates.gap: Statistics Poland reports 254 parishes total in 2024. The six territorial dioceses sum to 247 and the Military Ordinariate adds 7. The current official name roster exposes 244 non-military bodies and all 7 military parishes, leaving three non-military names unresolved.
candidates.needed: A current first-party name and location for each of the three bodies, with enough information to deduplicate it against the 244 named non-military roster rows.

candidates.gap: Statistics Poland reports 422 temples in 2024, including 7 military temples. The central roster is organized by parishes and other pastoral bodies and does not name every subordinate church or chapel.
candidates.needed: Current first-party object rosters for each diocese, reconciled against parish pages so subordinate temples are added once and remain attached to an active canonical body.

reconciliations.subject: Parish arithmetic
reconciliations.result: The 2024 total is 254, not 254 plus the Military Ordinariate. The territorial dioceses total 247 and the Military Ordinariate contributes 7.

reconciliations.subject: Military and civilian overlaps
reconciliations.result: All seven military parishes remain separate official bodies even where a civilian parish serves the same city or worship site.

reconciliations.subject: Monastic and parish overlaps
reconciliations.result: The twelve monastic institutions remain separate from same-place parish rows because the official sources identify them as distinct institutions.

reconciliations.subject: Historical monastic lists
reconciliations.result: Older references to Ujkowice or a Bialystok monastic community were not substituted for the 2024 official list. Only the seven monasteries, four religious houses, and one skete named in the current statistical return were published.
